   Plan: add hello.txt containing "hi"

   Context           

   The user wants a file hello.txt with the content hi in the repo at
   /tmp/scratch. The repo is empty: branch main, no commits, no
   files. Nothing exists to reuse and nothing will be overwritten.

   Steps

   1. Create /tmp/scratch/hello.txt with the Write tool. Content: hi
      followed by a single trailing newline (POSIX text-file convention).
   2. Don't commit. The user didn't ask for a commit.

   Verification

   - cat /tmp/scratch/hello.txt prints hi.
   - git -C /tmp/scratch status --short shows ?? hello.txt as
     the only change.
